in_sanskrit.name: अм्बिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अम् (Amb-) meaning no, not + बिक (Bika) meaning mother, hence, Ambika means the mother who gives or provides everything, without any denial or negation.

in_hindi.name: अм्बिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: माता (Mata) meaning mother + का (Ka) meaning having, hence, Ambika means the mother who has or possesses everything.

in_tamil.name: அம்பிகை
in_tamil.long_meaning: அம் (Am) meaning not + பிகை (Pigai) meaning mother, hence, Ambika means the mother who is free from any negation or denial.

in_telugu.name: అమ్బిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: అమ్ (Amb-) meaning not + బిక (Bik) meaning mother, hence, Ambika means the mother who is free from any negation or denial.

in_marathi.name: Ambika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ambika is the name of the goddess of the universe, also known as Parvati or Shiva's consort. The name Ambika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'amba,' which means 'mother.' This name is often associated with nurturing, compassion, and protection.
